parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of this entry. {{enum}} The {{enum|Error}} value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: Specifies the Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) or IP address of RADIUS client that the RadSecProxy service communicates with.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description: Specifies the type (protocol) of the Client.

parameters.name: Secret
parameters.description: Specifies the shared RADIUS key with the server. This option is optional for TLS/DTLS and if omitted will default to "radsec". Note that using a secret other than "radsec" for TLS is a violation of the standard {{bibref|RFC6614}} and that the proposed standard for DTLS stipulates that the secret must be "radius/dtls".

parameters.name: TLS
parameters.description: Specifies the TLS Block to be used by this client.

object.description: Client block configuration of the RadSecProxy service.
